name: aipe-magnetics
description: Magnetic engineering expert: material lookup and comparison, flux density and saturation screening, Steinmetz/iGSE core-loss estimation, inductor and transformer design calculations, winding loss, operating-point validation and engineering reports. All numbers come from the aipe-magnetics Python engine through its local MCP server (no LLM arithmetic, no cloud services, no API keys).

interface.shortDescription: Magnetic component design and loss modelling expert
interface.longDescription: Evidence-first magnetic engineering for power electronics: catalogue material lookup, Steinmetz and iGSE core-loss estimation with declared validity ranges, Jiles-Atherton hysteresis evaluation, basic inductor and transformer sizing, Dowell winding-loss estimation, saturation screening, operating-point validation and traceable engineering reports. Requires the aipe-magnetics Python package (pip install 'aipe-magnetics[mcp]') on the local machine.
defaultPrompt: Compare N87 and 3C94 at 100 kHz, 150 mT and 90 degC
Design a 10 kW 100 kHz DAB transformer with N87 cores
Review this inductor design for saturation and losses
